title: Create the Q2 earnings and lender narrative
prompt:
Create this file:
`Deliverables/Q2 earnings and lender narrative - 7.4.docx`

Daniel needs the Q2 narrative ready for the board and lender review. Start with the Q2 board, lender, and investor-relations thread in `Requests/`, including the source-tie follow-up. Use the current controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts, and treat earlier versions only as change history. Resolve conflicts using approval status, dates, document status, and management correspondence. Reconcile posted Alder Ridge balances through the contractor-accounting MCP, while keeping market evidence and bank terms tied to their own controlling sources.

Prepare a polished management narrative with `Executive Summary`, `Quarterly Performance`, `Segment Performance`, `Cash Flow and Liquidity`, `Credit Metrics`, `Outlook`, and `Appendix: KPI Definitions`. Explain why Q2 revenue and adjusted EBITDA moved differently from plan, rank the supported operating drivers by financial impact, and reconcile free cash flow. Present lender leverage and fixed-charge coverage from posted funded debt and the approved LTM EBITDA basis using the executed definitions.

Make an explicit recommendation on whether to hold or revise the published guidance. Support the call with the signed downside stress, headroom to the published EBITDA low end, headroom to the formal update trigger, and a measurable monitoring threshold. State the latest approved outlook, quantify the principal risks and opportunities, and assign actions, owners, and timing. Use the review notes and signed policy to determine the controller-tie headline basis. Keep the branch-mapped Board Performance, GAAP-posted, IR-comparable, and lender covenant measures separately labeled and reconciled rather than blending them.

Cite the controlling sources in the document and save the final Word file to the exact target path. Leave no draft scripts or temporary exports in the shared company workspace.
